newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Platform for Australia Wandoo oil field installed.
newsitem.headline: Platform for Australia Wandoo oil field installed.

text.p: Brown & Root, a wholly owned unit of Halliburton Co of the U.S., said on Monday it had installed a floating production platform at Australia's Wandoo oil field.
The $480 million 6,500-tonne production deck is to be installed onto a concrete substructure with crude storage capacity of 400,000 barrels, a statement from the company in Singapore said.
The platform is designed to increase production at the Wandoo field offshore Western Australia to 40,000 barrels per day from March. The field has been producing at 10,000 bpd previously.
Wandoo is operated by Mobil Corp unit Ampolex Ltd.
Brown & Root is part of a consortium developing the field. It comprises Leighton Contractors Pty Ltd, Ove Arup and Partners and the Keppel Corp.
The field, with 75 million barrels of recoverable reserves, produces a heavy crude with an American Petroleum Institute gravity of 19.4 degrees.
